content: उपधाव् .²1 <ls>U. 1</ls> To run towards, approach hastily; येन साम्ना स्तोष्यन् स्यात् तत्सामोपधावेत् <ls>Ch. Up. 1. 3. 8</ls>. .²2 To resort to; to have recourse to for assistance; तं भूतनिलयं देवं सुपर्णमुपधावत <ls>Bhāg. 8. 1. 11</ls>. .²3 To run, glide (<ab>Ā.</ab>); <ls>Rv. 8. 3. 21</ls>. .²4 To worship.
